title: Spot-check coverage slate and ad-hoc effort estimator
content:
Purpose:
Quick lightweight tracker for planning a 2-week spot-check sweep across regional fallback routes, customer-impacting endpoints, and ad-hoc coverage gaps. Intended to be used by on-call leads, product-ops, and SREs to estimate uplift effort and handoff owners for short bursts (<= 2 weeks).

Notes to self / context:
- This is intentionally rough: row-level columns are minimal so folks can copy into a Sheet and pivot as needed.
- Goal: decide who can take each target within current sprint or whether we need a dedicated surge buckle (1-2 FTE wks).
- Where possible include quick cost delta (rough $USD delta if we scale capacity / add reserved slots).
- Keep the list cross-functional but avoid gating on long approvals.

Tracker columns (CSV style below):
Target, Region, Route/Endpoint, Current owner, Priority(1-3), Risk summary, Est. extra hours, Est. FTE wks, Quick mitigation action, Blockers, Notes/links

Rows:
1) Conversational-hosted-fallback, NA-west, /v1/chat/generate, Platform-RO, 1, Latency spikes during morning batch window, 18, 0.5, short-term: add 2 reserved slots + enable prefix caching, Capacity quota request pending (REQ-119), Need cost ok from finance (see linked budget note)
2) Embeddings-batch-retry, EU, /v1/embeddings/batch, SE-ML, 2, Failed job retries causing backlog, 12, 0.33, increase retry window and add retry queue processor, Dependency: infra PR for queue worker (GH#4521), Link: Linear PROD-412
3) Dedicated-route-canary, APAC, /dedicated/predict, Infra-Ops, 1, Canary rollouts not failing over cleanly, 24, 0.67, add health-check and automatic failover policy, Blocker: missing runbook ownership, TODO: who owns failover doc? @Arjun
4) KV-cache-eviction, NA-east, internal-kv, Serving-Runtime, 3, Aggressive eviction for long-tail prompts, 8, 0.2, tune TTL and instrument eviction metrics, No blockers, short PR: ops/kv-tuning
5) Model-quant-profile, Global, catalog, Applied-ML, 2, Quantization regressions for certain prompts, 20, 0.56, create small eval set and run ablation, Blocker: access to full eval infra during weekend, Ask: schedule 2h with infra
6) Observability-sampling, EU, metrics-route, Observability, 2, Oversampled traces increase ingestion cost, 10, 0.28, reduce sampling to 1% on low-priority routes, No blockers, Estimated monthly cost reduction ~$1,200
7) Customer-bridge-handshake, Global, onboarding endpoints, Solutions-Eng, 1, Large customer integration flaky, 30, 0.83, temporarily route to Dedicated pool for this customer, Blocker: contract change needed (legal), Link: JIRA OPS-9876
8) Canary-telemetry-gaps, NA, rollout-telemetry, Product-Host, 2, Missing telemetry on edge nodes, 14, 0.39, deploy lightweight telemetry agent to 10% nodes, Blocker: infra maintenance window

Quick totals (sum-of-estimates):
- Total est. extra hours: 136h
- Equivalent FTE weeks (~40h week): 3.4 FTE wks
- Quick cost bump if we reserve slots for high-priority items: ~ $8k-$12k one-off (guestimate)

Priority guide (how to choose):
- 1 = customer-impacting / SLO-critical (address this week if possible)
- 2 = moderate impact, schedule in next 2 sprints
- 3 = low impact / tuning, backlog friendly

Risk notes / non-obvious tradeoffs:
- Reserving capacity reduces tail latency risk but increases cost linearly; compare to potential SLA credits for missed SLOs.
- Short-lived instrumentation changes can temporarily increase ingestion/billing; track delta in the first 48 hours.
- For model/eval items, full validation requires access to private eval infra—plan for weekend runs to avoid production contention.

Quick decisions to make today (owner ticks):
- Decide which two Priority-1 rows we can commit to this sprint (owner: Miguel)
- Approve temporary reserved capacity budget <$12k for the week of 6/19 (owner: Finance lead, ping @Priya)
- Confirm runbook owner for Dedicated failover (owner: Arjun)

Hand-off schedule suggestion (very lightweight):
- Week 1 (6/19–6/25): pick up rows 1, 3, 7 (rotate 1 primary owner from platform/infra/solutions)
- Week 2 (6/26–7/02): finish rows 2, 4, 6; start rows 5 and 8 if infra windows open

Open questions / TODOs:
- Who signs off on legal change for routing a customer to Dedicated transiently? (assigned: Priya to coordinate with Legal)
- Can Finance greenlight up to $12k without full PO process? Quick answer needed by 6/17.
- Is there a preferred Slack cadence for daily check-ins? Proposed: 15-min async thread update in #prod-ops each morning.

- Side effects (cost bump, SLO improvement, regressions)
- Follow-ups (long-lived fixes to schedule into roadmap)
